source: Yahoo Finance quoteSummary, trailing twelve months
refresh_note: Snapshot of valuation multiples for the dashboard's stock symbols. The daily refresh agent must regenerate this file alongside 3-history.json: for each symbol query Yahoo Finance quoteSummary modules=financialData,defaultKeyStatistics,summaryDetail,price (ENLT.TA for TASE:ENLT). pe=summaryDetail.trailingPE (null when trailing EPS is negative), pb=defaultKeyStatistics.priceToBook divided by 100 for ILA-priced symbols, ps=price.marketCap/totalRevenue with marketCap converted to the financialCurrency when they differ (USDILS=X for ENLT). Non-stock symbols (indices, commodities, FX, crypto) are intentionally absent so the UI can show its not-applicable note.
